heading: Coal-fired diesel engines
lead: The Secretary shall conduct a program of research, development, demonstration, and commercial application for utilizing coal-derived liquid or gaseous fuels, including ultra-clean coal-water slurries, in diesel engines. The program shall address—

tree.text: the testing of low-Btu highly reactive fuels;
fuel delivery and storage systems requirements; and
other infrastructure required to support commercial deployment.
